name: repair_check_v1
basis: Only the two new historical regressions in017; no018 model calls or fresh source inspection
control: Unchanged017 progress policy (native_roundtrip + full history + edit_checkpoint_v1)
candidate: Same017 progress policy plus temporary verification reminder after a valid editable source change
trigger: At least one allowed file currently differs and no allowed file is invalid. Determine whether the standalone declared regression command ran on current stable source bytes.
recognized_command: Exact declared regression command after outer whitespace removal, optionally prefixed by literal cd /work && . Compound edits, pipes, redirects, status wrappers and equivalent commands remain unverified; no shell parsing or success guessing.
evidence: Recorded executed action, returncode and editable source hash before/after it. Both arms observe this evidence. No final grader feedback, extra tools or oracle tests are given to the agent.

reminders.prefix: [Repair verification] {used} of {limit} model calls used; {remaining} remain including this request. Source bytes have changed, which does not establish correctness. {status}
reminders.unchecked: Run the declared regression command as a standalone command (optionally preceded by cd /work &&): {command} . Do not pipe it to tail/grep or append a successful command: that can hide a failing exit status. Read the actual failures, not just whether the shell command completed.
reminders.failed: Use the smallest failing assertion to identify the violated behavior. Check the surrounding callers and existing helpers; preserve adjacent cases instead of replacing one failure with another. If output is truncated, use one focused test or a small source range. Make a minimal evidence-based correction, then rerun the declared regression command without a pipe. Reserve remaining calls for the correction and verification; do not spend them only rereading or repeating an unchanged failing suite.
reminders.passed: The declared regression command exited zero on these source bytes. This is tool evidence, not the independent final grader. If the task requirements are satisfied, submit; avoid unrelated changes. Any further edit requires a new check.

limits: Same12calls,512output/call,6144totaloutput,8192input,2400tool-output characters,900s/task. Reminder tokens count against8192; no truncation, extra calls, forced tests, auto-patches or weight changes.
interpretation: A recorded exit-zero test is not independent success. Final success still requires the unchanged isolated grader; source edit or verification is only a secondary metric.
execution_sequence: All24historicalpairs then12freshpairs from2unusedrepositories; alternating arm order. Freeze all inputs and run both stages regardless of historical outcomes; no tuning after any018score.
